description: Universal Creative Component Library — 29 reusable component definitions across 4 creative domains (Graphic, Interior, Fashion, Packaging).

routesToMount.instruction: import designComponentsRouter from './design-components/router'; then add app.use('/ai/design-components', designComponentsRouter); after existing route mounts

pagesToRegister.instruction: Add <Route path='/design-components' component={DesignComponentsPage} /> inside the authenticated admin routes

sidebarItems.label: Component Library
sidebarItems.instruction: Add sidebar entry under the 'Design Tools' group (or create the group if absent)

dbSchemaToBarrel.instruction: Add: export { designComponentsTable, type DesignComponent, type NewDesignComponent } from './ai-design-components.js';

integrationOrder: 2. Add schema exports to lib/db barrel (see dbSchemaToBarrel above)
3. Run tsc -b in lib/db to rebuild types
5. Register page and sidebar in ai-platform

knownRisks.risk: designComponentService.ts imports lib/db schema via relative path (not barrel) until Team 24 adds barrel export. If the barrel is updated first, update the import path in designComponentService.ts accordingly.

The ai_design_components table must be created before the API server starts or POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE instance routes will fail with 'relation does not exist'. Registry and validate routes are stateless and safe regardless.

The frontend page fetches from /api/ai/design-components/registry at runtime — it shows an error state if the router is not yet mounted. The page is gracefully degraded (error message shown, not a crash).
